real_estate.name: Real estate and city choice
real_estate.model_template: Judges housing as an asset and life-efficiency tool, with emphasis on liquidity, city opportunity, household balance sheet, and exit cost.

stock_market.name: Stock market and investing
stock_market.model_template: Judges investments as tools rather than identities, with emphasis on valuation, rule changes, capital flow, and exit discipline.

employment.name: Employment and education
employment.model_template: Judges education and employment through city opportunity, job quality, family resources, and real supply-demand constraints.

manufacturing.name: Manufacturing and price competition
manufacturing.model_template: Judges manufacturing by whether competition allows efficient players to win through price, scale, supply chain, and export capacity.

macro_policy.name: Macro policy and public finance
macro_policy.model_template: Judges macro issues through policy goals, population structure, fiscal constraints, market mechanisms, and incentive alignment.

public_services.name: Public services
public_services.model_template: Judges public services by asking who pays, whether prices are controlled, whether fiscal funding covers costs, and how incentives shape behavior.
